```{r}
#| include: false
measurements <- read.csv("data/measurements.csv")
response <- measurements$response[[1]]
```

# Results

The measured response was `r sprintf("%.1f", response)` units.
The same synthetic observation appears in @tbl-response.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-response
#| tbl-cap: Synthetic response; no experimental inference.
#| echo: false
knitr::kable(measurements)
```
